svg.text: 2U rack chassis, motherboard with module slots, host-attached. Generated from hw/board_psram.yaml by hw/kicad_gen.py. Blue: ring ribbons on In2.Cu; pink: core-rail islands on In3.Cu. Rear of the chassis at the bottom.

Memory, PCIe and management nets are unrouted. Longest lane per hop: FPGA -> A0 64 mm; A0 -> A1 65 mm; A1 -> A2 65 mm; A2 -> A3 65 mm; A3 -> A4 65 mm; A4 -> A5 142 mm; A5 -> A6 65 mm; A6 -> A7 65 mm; A7 -> H0 65 mm; H0 -> H1 65 mm; H1 -> FPGA 110 mm
